title: Beyond Single Slot: Joint Optimization for Multi-Slot Guaranteed Display Advertising
abstract: arXiv:2605.21556v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Guaranteed display advertising is crucial for platform monetization, yet existing methods often operate under a single-slot assumption, limiting their ability to optimize allocation across multi-slot page views. In this paper, we propose a novel joint optimization framework for multi-slot GD allocation, addressing key challenges such as slot-level redundancy, contract imbalance, and exposure concentration. Our approach formulates the allocation as an offline bipartite matching problem with a contract roulette mechanism for slot exclusivity and Page View constraints for impression control, and incorporates a scalable allocation optimization algorithm for efficient large-scale deployment. Extensive online tests on the Meituan advertising platform demonstrate that our method significantly improves merchant ROI, platform revenue efficiency, and contract fulfillment robustness. Specifically, online A/B tests show a 28.99% increase in Aver

translated_title: 超越单槽位：多槽位保量展示广告的联合优化
translated_abstract: 保量展示广告对平台变现至关重要，然而现有方法通常基于单槽位假设运行，限制了其在多槽位页面浏览场景下优化分配的能力。本文提出了一种新颖的多槽位保量展示广告分配联合优化框架，解决了槽位级冗余、合约不平衡和曝光集中等关键挑战。我们的方法将分配问题建模为离线二部图匹配问题，引入合约轮盘机制实现槽位独占性，并通过页面浏览约束控制曝光，同时结合可扩展的分配优化算法以实现高效的大规模部署。在美团广告平台上的大量在线测试表明，我们的方法显著提升了商家ROI、平台收入效率以及合约履约的稳健性。具体而言，在线A/B测试显示平均值指标提升了28.99%。
tldr: 本文提出一种多槽位保量展示广告联合优化框架，将分配建模为带合约轮盘机制和页面浏览约束的离线二部图匹配问题，显著提升商家ROI、平台收入效率与合约履约稳健性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel joint optimization framework for multi-slot guaranteed display advertising, formulating allocation as offline bipartite matching with contract roulette and page view constraints, significantly improving merchant ROI, platform revenue efficiency, and contract fulfillment robustness.
